entities.summary: Anthony Joseph Fasano is an American former professional football player who was a tight end in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Dallas Cowboys in the second round of the 2006 NFL draft. He played college football for the Notre Dame Fighting Irish. Fasano also played for the Kansas City Chiefs, Tennessee Titans, and Miami Dolphins.
